title: TAVI — Completed Time (completed_time) on tasks, records API (agent fedelav803, build index-7qe5X0Gd.js)
lines: UI "Mark as Complete" on the same kind of task        → completed_time = 2026-10-26T10:45:55Z (sent by the browser)
PATCH completed_time = "2001-01-01T00:00:00Z" on an open task → 200, stored 2001-01-01T00:00:00Z
So the server neither fills nor protects Completed Time: API clients, imports and rules leave it empty, and any client can backdate it.
